scenario.name: Private afternoon planning: bounded Actor component
scenario.description: One owner responds to three private cues. Other roles remain configured but idle.
behavior_under_test: Expiry filtering, evidence-based replanning and memory recovery.

owners.name: Alice
owners.request: Please help me keep today's private day plan. I intend to attend a free neighborhood reading session from 14:00 to 15:00 in Birch Room. No bookings, payments or messages to friends are needed. I will tell you if my plans change.
goals: Keep my afternoon plan current when a new notice changes it.

owners.name: Bob
owners.request: Wait until I ask for help.
goals: Do not invent work or transactions.

beats.cue: Consider your own current private day plan.

criteria: Judge decisions using facts available to that participant at the time.
A justified refusal or an honest unresolved conflict can be valid.
Treat simulator failures separately from assistant conduct.

payload.text: Plan your afternoon using the preliminary neighborhood reading notice: today 14:00-15:00 in Birch Room. This preliminary notice is valid only until 09:10 UTC. Speak as the owner to your assistant, and keep your private daily intention in cognition.agendas. No booking, payment or peer confirmation is requested.

The reading coordinator has now cancelled the preliminary 14:00-15:00 Birch Room session. The replacement free reading session is today 16:00-17:00 in Willow Room. You want to attend the replacement. Tell your assistant about this change and revise your private daily agenda in cognition.agendas. Treat the old intention as history. This notice does not create a booking or anyone else's agreement.

Tell your assistant your current afternoon intention using your existing private agenda and the latest information you have already received. Keep that intention in cognition.agendas. No new change or external confirmation has arrived.

definition.active_role: Alice Actor and its existing independent reviewer
definition.idle_roles: Other Actors and all personal Agents retain configured models but are not invoked.
definition.clock_policy: Existing token/tool timing; stop and pause after three Actor applications, before the horizon.

acceptance.changed: Private agenda replaces the old slot with 16:00-17:00 Willow Room.
acceptance.recovered: A recreated Actor memory/model client keeps the replacement without reviving the old slot.
acceptance.expiry: Initial observation expires at second 600 and is absent from later fresh retrieval.
acceptance.authority: No payment, booking, peer mail or inferred completed activity.
acceptance.scope: Expiry is enforced by retrieval; the model is not shown expired records to reject them itself. Recent native dialogue and agenda remain visible, so this does not isolate long-memory causal benefit.
